summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 19 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing of BidPilot. 18/19 backend tests pass. The full real-AI 9-stage analysis pipeline via Claude completed in ~60s and produced valid decision + requirements. All seeded expectations verified (dashboard total=1, conditional=1, BID WITH CONDITIONS / 76% readiness, FAIL on 'Similar completed projects', NEEDS_REVIEW on ISO 9001, 7 seeded company docs, 3 notifications, Professional plan, 3 plans, sandbox upgrade). Evidence traceability works. Action items toggle & persist. Documents upload/delete works. Workspace isolation verified. Frontend: demo login lands on dashboard, sidebar nav works (except a testid naming quirk), all 9 analysis tabs render, FAIL filter works, Evidence Viewer opens with tender+company panes, decision stamp + export button visible, Action Plan toggle persists after reload, logout returns to login. Only 1 real backend bug found: brute-force lockout does not trigger because k8s ingress presents varying source IPs.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout never triggers behind k8s ingress. login_attempts is keyed by `request.client.host + email`, but ingress forwards requests with rotating internal pod IPs (observed 10.208.134.66 and 10.208.134.70 for a single client session). Counts never reach MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 for one identifier. Fix: derive client IP from X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP header, or key attempts by email only (safer for account lockout).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for Users & Roles becomes 'nav-users---roles' (triple dash) because the transform replaces both spaces AND & separately. Cosmetic but inconsistent with 'nav-users' expected in the review request.

action_items: Fix brute-force lockout: use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) or key login_attempts on email only so 5+ wrong password attempts consistently return 429.
(Optional cosmetic) Simplify nav data-testid generation so Users & Roles yields 'nav-users' (or 'nav-users-roles') instead of 'nav-users---roles'.

rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout: `request.client.host` returns the immediate peer IP. In this k8s deployment, requests reach FastAPI via an ingress/service proxy whose source IP rotates across pods/hops. Each attempt therefore lands in a distinct `login_attempts` document, never accumulating past 4. Reproduction: 7 consecutive POST /api/auth/login with wrong password → 7×401, no 429. DB inspection shows two identifiers (10.208.134.66:… and 10.208.134.70:…) with counts 4 and 3. Mitigation: parse X-Forwarded-For (first non-private IP) or drop the IP dimension and rate-limit strictly by email.
